description: Lightweight, expression-tree-compiled dependency injection container for .NET 8/9/10. From-scratch with no Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection dependency. Open generics, decorators, Lazy/Func/Owned auto-resolution, lifecycle hooks (OnActivating / OnActivated), validate-on-build, async disposal, child scopes with extra registrations, modules, assembly scanning, keyed services, and IEnumerable / IReadOnlyDictionary collection injection.
releaseNotes:
v0.5.0: Release-blocking engine fixes and keyed-service semantics. First version published to nuget.org after 0.2.0 (0.3.0 and 0.4.0 never shipped because CI failed), so it also carries everything listed under v0.4.0 and v0.3.0.

Added:
  * RegisterDecorator(Type serviceType, Type decoratorType) on IContainerBuilder, so open-generic decorators (IRepository<> -> LoggingRepository<>) are reachable from the public API. An open-generic decorator also wraps closed-only base registrations.
  * ServiceNotRegisteredException.Key; the keyed-miss message now names the key.

Fixed:
  * A singleton whose construction throws is retried on the next resolve instead of replaying the cached exception.
  * Same-thread singleton cycles throw CircularDependencyException (not InvalidOperationException); a cross-thread singleton cycle is detected and reported instead of deadlocking.
  * ResolveKeyed / TryResolveKeyed find keyed open-generic registrations and keyed registrations added to a child scope via BeginLifetimeScope.
  * TryResolve / ResolveOptional of Lazy<T>, Func<T>, Owned<T> answer false / null when T is not registered (Owned<T> used to throw; Lazy/Func used to fail later on use).

Changed:
  * Keyed registrations are no longer the default: Resolve<T>() and IEnumerable<T> / ResolveAll<T>() skip WithKey(...) registrations, and IsRegistered<T>() answers for unkeyed registrations only. Keyed services stay reachable via ResolveKeyed / TryResolveKeyed / ResolveDictionary. This restores Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection keyed-service semantics through the sidecar.

v0.4.0: Engine hardening, faster resolution, and a richer resolution API.

Added:
  * Public keyed resolution: ResolveKeyed<T>(key), ResolveKeyed(Type, key), TryResolveKeyed<T>(key, out value) on IResolver.
  * Non-throwing resolution: TryResolve<T>(out value) and ResolveOptional<T>() (plus Type overloads).
  * Registration probe: IContainer.IsRegistered<T>() / IsRegistered(Type).
  * Open-generic decorators: RegisterDecorator on an open generic now wraps closed resolutions; decorators are pre-indexed by service type.
  * Non-public [Inject] methods are now invoked, matching property injection.

Fixed / changed:
  * Concurrency: _byServiceType is a ConcurrentDictionary, fixing a data race when open generics are closed under concurrent load.
  * Singletons are constructed exactly once under parallel resolution.
  * Lock-free activator caches plus a registration-lookup-before-collection fast path cut per-resolve overhead and lock contention.
  * Func<T> / Lazy<T> / Func<P, T> activators are cached (Func<P, T> no longer recompiles its expression per resolve).

For ASP.NET Core / Generic Host integration use the TechTeaStudio.Injector.Extensions.DependencyInjection sidecar package.

Full changelog: https://github.com/TechTeaStudio/Injector/blob/product/CHANGELOG.md
